en.name: Pumpkin seeds, raw, hulled
en.summary: Raw hulled pumpkin seeds keep 6 months in a cool, dry cupboard, and the same 6 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. The cold does not extend them on paper, but it is still the better place for them in a warm kitchen.
en.pantry: 6 months in an airtight, preferably opaque container, cool, dark and dry. Hulled seeds have no shell left to protect them, so the oil inside is exposed to air and oxidation is the clock. Nothing grows in a dry seed, so this is a flavour limit rather than a safety one: old pepitas taste bitter and slightly fishy rather than sweet and green. Keep them away from the hob and out of direct light, both of which speed the oil up.
en.fridge: 6 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, sealed. That is the same figure as the cupboard, which is unusual and worth reading carefully: the published life does not get longer, but in a hot, humid kitchen the fridge is where the seeds will actually come closest to reaching it. Use a properly airtight jar, since the seeds pick up fridge smells, and let it warm before opening so condensation does not land on them.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for raw hulled pumpkin seeds. Freezing does them no harm and is a reasonable way to park a bulk bag — the seed holds very little water so the texture is unaffected — but there is no published figure to give you, so treat it as sensible practice rather than a documented limit. Double-bag and press the air out.
en.thawing: No thawing needed; use them straight from cold. Let a sealed container come back to room temperature before opening it.
spoilage: A bitter or fishy taste, which is the seed oil gone rancid.
A smell of old cooking oil or paint rather than fresh and green.
Seeds that are chewy and limp instead of crisp — moisture has got in.
Mould, webbing or grubs in a jar that got damp or was left open.
tips: Buy from somewhere with turnover; hulled seeds may already be months old.
Store in an opaque airtight jar; light drives oxidation as much as heat does.
Toast only what you need — toasted seeds turn faster than raw ones.
Taste a few before scattering them over a salad or folding them into bread.

faq.q: How long do raw pumpkin seeds keep?
faq.a: 6 months in an airtight container in a cool, dry cupboard, or 6 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.

faq.q: Should pumpkin seeds be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: The published figure is the same either way, but in a hot or humid kitchen the fridge is the more reliable place to get there.

faq.q: How can you tell if pumpkin seeds have gone bad?
faq.a: Taste a few. Rancid seeds are bitter and slightly fishy, and the flavour carries into anything you cook with them.

zh.name: 生南瓜籽仁（去殼）
zh.summary: 去殼的生南瓜籽仁放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 6 個月，放 4 °C 以下冷藏同樣是 6 個月。數字上冷藏並沒有拉長期限，但在悶熱的廚房裡，它仍然是比較好的位置。
zh.pantry: 氣密、最好不透光的容器，陰涼、避光、乾燥，6 個月。去殼之後沒有硬殼保護，裡面的油脂直接接觸空氣，在倒數的是氧化。乾燥的種子長不出東西，所以這是風味的期限而不是安全的期限：放久的南瓜籽仁吃起來是苦的、帶點腥，而不是清甜的青草香。請遠離爐台、避免直射光，這兩者都會讓油脂跑得更快。
zh.fridge: 密封放 4 °C 以下，6 個月。這和櫥櫃是同一個數字，有點少見，值得仔細讀：公布的期限並沒有變長，但在又熱又濕的廚房裡，冷藏才是真正讓種子有機會撐到那個數字的地方。請用真正氣密的罐子，因為它很會吸冰箱的味道；拿出來時先回溫再開，免得結露落在種子上。
zh.freezer: 去殼生南瓜籽仁沒有冷凍的期限數據。冷凍不會傷到它，大包裝先冰起來也很合理——種子含水極少，質地不受影響——但沒有公開數字可以給你，所以請當成合理做法，而不是有憑有據的上限。請雙層裝袋並壓出空氣。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍，直接從低溫取用。密封容器請回到室溫再打開。
spoilage: 嚐起來發苦或帶腥味，那是種子油油耗。
聞起來像久放的油或油漆，而不是清新的青草味。
咬起來軟韌不脆——水氣跑進去了。
受潮或忘了蓋的罐子出現霉、絲網或小蟲。
tips: 跟流通快的店家買；去殼的種子可能已經放了好幾個月。
用不透光的氣密罐；光線推動氧化的力道和溫度一樣大。
要用多少才烘多少，烘過的種子比生的更快走味。
撒進沙拉或揉進麵團前，先吃幾顆確認。

faq.a: 氣密容器放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃 6 個月，或 4 °C 以下冷藏 6 個月。
公布的數字兩邊一樣，但在又熱又濕的廚房，冷藏比較有機會真的撐到那個數字。
吃幾顆。油耗的南瓜籽會苦、帶點腥，而且這個味道會跟著進到料理裡。
